_comment: Per-project fleet overrides for omniswim-suite. Merged over the global fleet.config.json at C:/Users/nihar/superintelligent/fleet.config.json. Pools and the usage ledger stay global — a quota belongs to a subscription, not a repo.

policy._why: CLAUDE.md rule: 'No git operations (commits, pushes, branches) — agents work on diffs only.' isolateByDefault enforces that mechanically: every assignment runs in its own worktree and comes back as a patch, so no delegated agent can ever touch this working tree or this branch.
policy._why_concurrency: CLAUDE.md rule: 'Keep concurrent agents in disjoint package scopes.' Three at a time is the practical ceiling before scopes start overlapping in this monorepo.
policy._why_fallback: This repo's runs are long and Opus has historically hit session limits mid-task. A deeper chain means a limit costs a handoff instead of a lost run.

models._comment: This is a large TypeScript monorepo — scoring logic, roster/lineup correctness and extraction pipelines all need to hold a lot of the tree at once. Bump longContext and breadth where the model genuinely has it, so 'needs: refactor' and 'needs: research' land somewhere that can actually see the codebase.

Data-provenance work (cutlines, teamDivisions, parsers) is the highest-stakes code here and fails silently when wrong. Keep the cheap models out of it by making them ineligible for review-shaped needs rather than by ranking them.
